text:
Hana: Quick tiny shoutout to Priya + Leo for the midnight hotfix  demo saved, applause please. :crane:
Priya: thanks! Leo found the race condition in 10m. coffee for Leo? :coffee: :trophy:
Leo: coffee accepted. also big thanks to Marta for the quick design swap on the slide.
Sofia: can we make a micro-ritual? something physical and low-friction to hand out when someone saves the day. not stickers (we already do stickers)  thinking origami cranes in a capsule? :thinking:
Marta: love the idea. I can design tiny crane stickers and origami instruction cards. "Fold a crane, pass the thanks" vibe.
Jai: quirky and memorable. vending capsule idea: a small clear jar with folded cranes and a note inside when you pull one you read the shoutout.
Hana: vote: react with :crane: for crane-capsule, :label: for more stickers, :card_index: for handwritten mini-cards
Priya: :crane: -- love tactile.
Leo: :crane: too. makes the ritual feel deliberate.
Marta: I'll mock up a sheet: 3 crane stickers + 20 tiny instruction cards. 2 designs: "Saved the Demo" and "Runbook Hero"
ops-bot: note: midnight-hotfix-2026-03-20 resolved by Priya, Leo | no customer impact. :white_check_mark:
Sofia: logistics: who can fold the first 30 cranes? volunteer sign-up  takes ~15m.
Jai: I can fold after lunch. tiny origami party in the kitchen? snacks provided. :popcorn:
Hana: please also add a one-line to the weekly digest: "micro-win: Priya + Leo hotfix prevented demo issue (crane-capsule launched)"
Marta: GIF for digest: https://giphy.com/gifs/thank-you-3o6ZtaO9BZHcOjmErm
Priya: cute extra: we'll leave a sharpie by the capsule so people can write initials/date on the back of the card they pull.
Leo: also note: keep one envelope of GF cookies in the kitchen labeled "Crane Fuel" for the folding crew.
Sofia: final: crates/capsule on the whiteboard shelf tomorrow. first crane pull after standup.
Hana: thank you all  small rituals = big morale. :sparkles:
